name: Feasibility spike: prove the dev-loop mechanism on a real shop
description:
Gate deliverable, not shippable product code. On a real shop, prove: HTML interception (text/html only), marker-anchored byte-splice injection, same-origin dev-asset serving, session survival across cookies/redirects/session-sensitive routes (cart/checkout/account), and correct detection/reporting of which version is being rendered.

Record real response headers, cookie flags, redirect chains, and any bot/WAF behavior encountered — this becomes the first fixture corpus for §12.

The Phase 2 (MVP dev-loop) design is not committed until this passes. If it fails, scope changes here, cheaply, rather than after Phase 2 is built.
